name: accelbyte-ai-plugins
description: Public AI coding agents, skills, and MCP servers for AccelByte.

interface.longDescription: Build on AccelByte Gaming Services (AGS) with an assistant that knows the platform. Ask about player login, matchmaking, sessions, leaderboards, store and other AGS modules; scaffold, run and deploy Extend apps; and review an existing AccelByte integration for incomplete flows, deprecated APIs and auth-token safety. The bundled Extend SDK server lets the assistant look up real Extend SDK types and functions instead of guessing them.
capabilities: Look up Extend SDK types and functions
